name: Attached To Target
description: An AWS Organizations policy is attached to a target in an AWS Organizations tree: an OU, a member account, or the organization, which stands for its root (policy -> target). AWS's own terms: organizations:AttachPolicy(PolicyId, TargetId) and ListTargetsForPolicy. The `_TO` is the locative preposition of 'attached to', not a direction marker. Scoped to AWS Organizations policies (service control policies, and the other policy types an organization enables: RCPs, tag policies, declarative policies); it is not a generic attachment edge.
